svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Match Day puts a floodlit night match on your wrist: the stadium lights pulse, the
crowd twinkles and a live score complication (runs, wickets, overs) reads in a single glance. Condensed Bebas digits
stay large and cream-white against the deep navy sky, and in a tense final over the edge of the screen glows red with
your heartbeat. The always-on state keeps only the time on true black, and a medallion variant frames the ground in a
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
